scope: Non-destructive routing risk check for remote-only Edge Function conflict slugs after reviewed launch functions were deployed.

pgCronJobTable.command: npx supabase db query --linked "select to_regclass('cron.job') is not null as cron_job_table_exists;"
pgCronJobTable.conclusion: No pg_cron job table is present on the linked hosted database, so these functions are not evidenced as scheduled from pg_cron.

mitigation.command: npx supabase functions deploy dispatch-outbox enqueue-message process-inbound public-contact queue-reminders resend-webhook twilio-webhook --project-ref mgadheotkdnrsatfivjy --no-verify-jwt --use-api
mitigation.strategy: Deployed explicit disabled stubs for legacy conflict slugs. Stubs return HTTP 410 with a replacement route hint instead of executing legacy worker/webhook/contact behavior.

replacementRoutes.public-contact: direct contact_submissions insert guarded by database trigger

remainingRisk: External provider dashboards or third-party callers may still point to legacy webhook URLs.
Any stale caller hitting a legacy slug should now receive HTTP 410; provider dashboards still need to be updated to the reviewed replacement webhook URLs before live provider use.
